_doc: Cruise line compliance policy registry for core/compliance/cruise_line_policy_checker.py. Rules that came directly from the tasking brief (2026-07-06) are tagged CONFIRMED with that source. Rules filled from general industry knowledge (not verified against a live cruise-line source this session) are tagged INFERRED. Anything not yet sourced is UNKNOWN and the checker skips that test rather than fabricate a result (Negative-Space Rule, SO-PIPELINE-INTEGRITY-20260528). Sterling/Whetstone: replace INFERRED/UNKNOWN entries with CONFIRMED once verified against each line's official passenger contract / guest policy pages, then bump confidence.

_schema.aliases: array of strings matched case-insensitively against the cruise_line input to resolve to this entry
_schema.rules.min_age_alcohol_service: integer minimum age to be served alcohol / access premium bars
_schema.rules.min_age_casino: integer minimum age to enter/play the casino
_schema.rules.passport_validity_days_required: integer days of passport validity required beyond the sail date (return-date buffer)
_schema.rules.mobility_aid_preapproval_required: boolean — wheelchairs/scooters/non-collapsible mobility aids need pre-cruise clearance
_schema.rules.medical_equipment_requiring_preapp: array of medical equipment/conditions that require a pre-cruise medical form or special services desk notification (e.g. oxygen, dialysis, CPAP w/ supplemental O2)
_schema.rules.dress_code_enforced: boolean — formal/smart-casual dress code is enforced in specialty venues
_schema.rules.visa_notes: free-text notes on visa posture; the checker does not auto-determine visa need (nationality + itinerary dependent) but surfaces this note
